coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass: 14 captured search invocations containing 56 search strings and 440 returned result headers. English- and French-language country-wide, week-binned, province/city, labour/healthcare, climate, housing, Indigenous, and Ottawa anniversary searches were used. Eight source bodies were reviewed; seven cards remain search-only and one exact URL returned only a cache miss. Candidate leads remain pending on attendance, state-directed demands, or body evidence. CBC/Radio-Canada domain searches encountered access/robots limits; no LexisNexis/archive sweep or official original baseline was verified. This does not establish absence or exhaustive coverage.
